claims.text: WriterZen pulls data from Google keyword and suggestion databases to generate keywords and topics for SEO rankings

quote.text: WriterZen is a toolset that pulls data from Google keyword and suggestion databases to generate keywords and topics that can improve your SEO rankings.

claims.text: Topic discovery finds low-competition, high-relevancy topics to build topic clusters

quote.text: The topic discovery tool lets you find strategic topics with low competition and high relevancy, so you can build topic clusters that fill the gaps in your knowledge base.

claims.text: Developing topic clusters helps build authority and establish industry expertise

quote.text: Developing topic clusters based on untapped topic opportunities also helps you build authority and establish yourself as an industry expert.

claims.text: WriterZen guides users through SEO workflow to find relevant keywords for content ideas

quote.text: After you’ve chosen a topic, WriterZen will guide you through the next step in your SEO workflow to help you find relevant keywords that fit your content ideas.

claims.text: Provides metrics for relevancy, authority, search volume and competition to pick keywords

quote.text: Cutting-edge metrics developed by WriterZen’s in-house researchers make it easy to pick keywords based on their relevancy, authority, search volume, and competition.

claims.text: Can automatically cluster keywords based on ranking attributes

quote.text: You’ll be able to select and automatically cluster keywords based on ranking attributes.

claims.text: Content creator tool generates SEO-friendly content

quote.text: Once you're done with the topic discovery and keyword explorer tools, you can use the content creator tool to generate SEO-friendly content.

claims.text: Offers suggested NLP entities and sophisticated text editor

quote.text: Choose from suggested NLP entities to make your content comprehensible for the bots, then create a masterpiece using WriterZen’s sophisticated text editor.

claims.text: Includes built-in GPT-3 powered AI assistant for search-engine friendly content

quote.text: You can use the built-in GPT-3 powered AI assistant to create content that’s search-engine friendly and engaging to your audience.

claims.text: Plagiarism checker identifies duplicate content to avoid Google penalties

quote.text: The tool will identify any duplicate content or poorly paraphrased material, helping you avoid any Google penalties.

claims.text: Allows downloading reports and sharing with team for collaboration

quote.text: Plus, WriterZen lets you quickly download reports and share them with your team for simple collaboration.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased WriterZen can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: The vendor says you can only upgrade during the event, which time-limits the promise that previous customers can buy more codes to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: We offer a limited deal and you can only upgrade during the event.
exhibits.argument: This time-limits upgrades, contradicting the promise that previous customers can buy more codes to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: after using few days my limit is over and I cannot use my Ai writing next 2 weeks.
exhibits.argument: Even after stacking 4 codes the buyer hit limits, undermining that buying more codes increases limits enough.

exhibits.quote: may I confirm how to upgrade this kind of tools subs to tier 2 or tier 3 from tier 1 I currently use right now?
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms existing tier holders can upgrade to higher tiers to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: We offer a limited deal and you can only upgrade during the event.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states tier upgrades are available to increase limits.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: Reviews report the advertised Ahrefs SERP data feature was announced as removed for all users, showing previous buyers were not protected from losing features.

exhibits.quote: Sadly, just the other day they announced that Ahrefs SERP data removed.
exhibits.argument: A key feature was removed after purchase, contradicting being grandfathered into feature limits.

exhibits.quote: however all users have just received an email around 48 hours ago that this feature is being REMOVED.
exhibits.argument: Advertised SERP data was taken away from all users, showing prior buyers were not grandfathered.

trials.claim: WriterZen pulls data from Google keyword and suggestion databases to generate keywords and topics for SEO rankings
trials.claimQuote: WriterZen is a toolset that pulls data from Google keyword and suggestion databases to generate keywords and topics that can improve your SEO rankings.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it leverages Google's search database and a buyer confirms extracting keywords from Google in real time; complaints about accuracy do not deny that Google is the source.

exhibits.quote: They said data was taken from Google but the data displayed by the tool, do not match when I compare it with Google data.
exhibits.argument: Buyer comparison found tool data does not match Google data, undermining Google-database accuracy claim.

exhibits.quote: When I manually look at the first Google page, I get more information than WriterZen gave me.
exhibits.argument: Manual Google check yielded more information than the tool, undermining its Google-data generation value.

exhibits.quote: Leverage Google's search database for unfair ranking advantage.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states its keyword tool leverages Google search database for ranking advantage.

exhibits.quote: extracting keywords from Google to provide real-time data instantly.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool extracts keywords from Google with real-time data.

trials.claim: Topic discovery finds low-competition, high-relevancy topics to build topic clusters
trials.claimQuote: The topic discovery tool lets you find strategic topics with low competition and high relevancy, so you can build topic clusters that fill the gaps in your knowledge base.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report topic results were not relevant and only inappropriate keywords, directly conflicting with the high-relevancy topic discovery claim and outweighing the single positive review.

exhibits.quote: NONE of the results was US based and NONE of it is relevant.
exhibits.argument: Topic research returned zero relevant results, contradicting high-relevancy topic discovery.

exhibits.quote: I only got inappropriate keywords and found the whole workflow quite bad.
exhibits.argument: Buyer got only inappropriate keywords, undermining low-competition high-relevancy topic discovery.

exhibits.quote: Unleash hundreds of laser-targeted clustered topics from one keyword and gain access to keyword insights that go beyond mere numbers for months of content creation.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes Topic Discovery as producing clustered topics from one keyword.

exhibits.quote: I can brainstorm content ideas quickly with Topic Discovery, and finding those sweet low-competition keywords.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms Topic Discovery finds low-competition keywords for content ideas.

trials.claim: Developing topic clusters helps build authority and establish industry expertise
trials.claimQuote: Developing topic clusters based on untapped topic opportunities also helps you build authority and establish yourself as an industry expert.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only say keyword output felt dangerous or potentially time-wasting; none directly measure whether topic clusters build authority or industry expertise.

exhibits.quote: The kind of keywords research output is outright dangerous for me to follow, if I didn't know any better.
exhibits.argument: Output described as dangerous to follow undermines building authority and expertise from topic clusters.

exhibits.quote: I worry that I’ll waste a lot of time creating content going directions that aren’t beneficial..
exhibits.argument: Buyer fears generated topics lead in non-beneficial directions, undermining authority-building claim.
